title.description: Title of the report (e.g., 'AWR Performance Analysis', 'Invalid Object Inventory').

item_name.description: The metric, parameter, or object found.

current_value.description: The actual value or status observed.

expected_value.description: The baseline or recommended value (if applicable).

findings.description: The raw data payload, list of objects, or parameter diffs.

overall_health.description: Current state of the inspected target.

inspection_summary.description: High-level summary of what was found during the inspection.

visual_aid_suggested.description: Whether a chart or dashboard mockup would help.

action.description: What to change to fix a degraded finding.

command.description: The SQL/CLI command to apply the tune.

tuning_recommendations.description: Actionable fixes for any negative findings.

image_generation_prompt.description: Detailed prompt for generating a chart (pie/bar/line) or dashboard layout visualizing the findings.
